components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--volt, #D2FF3A); color: var(--ink, #12141C); padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 15px/1 Golos Text, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D2FF3A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border: 1px solid rgba(232,238,246,0.2); color: #E8EEF6; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 15px/1 Golos Text, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #D2FF3A; color: #D2FF3A; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Mono pill for tech and demo labels.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(232,238,246,0.15); background: rgba(232,238,246,0.08); color: #E8EEF6; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 400 11px/1 JetBrains Mono, monospace; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio is a live product console. Color owns whole fields. Volt is the only interactive accent.
keyCharacteristics: Split hero with live instrument cluster

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No uppercase label above section headings.
